probes.procedure: Inspect node1 as an independent initialized Transit seal provider and nodes2-node4 as one unsealed three-voter integrated-storage cluster with exactly one leader. Through protected administrative environments read proof=raft-auto-unseal and create/read/delete a unique versioned KV value through more than one Raft endpoint.
probes.cleanup: Delete evaluator KV state and leave the required proof secret and all four Vault services healthy.

probes.procedure: Inspect failed units, development/duplicate Vault processes, stale archives/installers, exposed shares/tokens, overbroad policies, debug listeners, abandoned snapshots, conflicting configuration, and executor-created residue.

assertions.pass_condition: Node1 is an independent Transit provider and nodes2-node4 are one unsealed three-voter Raft cluster with exactly one leader.
assertions.fail_condition: Authenticated live state confirms wrong role, sealed member, missing voter, split/no leader, or non-integrated storage topology.

assertions.pass_condition: proof=raft-auto-unseal is readable and evaluator versioned KV write/read/delete works through more than one Raft endpoint.
assertions.fail_condition: Healthy authenticated endpoints confirm missing proof, inconsistent data, or failed multi-endpoint KV operations.

assertions.pass_condition: Only required Transit/Raft storage, PKI, audit, protected administration, recovery, and operational state remains.
assertions.fail_condition: Concrete failed, dev, duplicate, stale, overbroad, secret-bearing, debug, temporary, or abandoned executor state remains.
